newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed 39 Kurdish guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed 39 Kurdish guerrillas.

text.p: Turkish security forces have killed 39 Kurdish guerrillas in the southeast of the country in recent clashes, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the clashes took place in Batman, Sirnak and Bingol provinces on Wednesday and Thursday. It did not give any figures for military casualties.
More than 21,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old conflict between Turkish troops and Kurdistan Workers Party rebels, fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
